PR163 @cursor[bot] packages/core/src/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts:545
### Startup reclaim skipped on typical launches

**Medium Severity**

<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
Orphan run reclaim is tied to `reclaimStaleTurns`, but the desktop app only passes that when cwd is a git repo. Packaged Dock launches skip that block, so after a crash or force-quit the UI can still show stale `activeRuns` and leftover listeners are not cleared until the user hits Stop.
<!-- DESCRIPTION END -->

PR163 @cursor[bot] packages/core/src/hook/conductor.ts:274
### Port kill blocks the main thread

**Medium Severity**

<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
`killListenersOnPorts` now uses `execFileSync` with a login `zsh` (or PowerShell) once per persisted port. Each run records a 10-port range, and Stop/quit invoke this on the Electron main thread, so the UI and `will-quit` can stall for seconds while shells source rc files.
<!-- DESCRIPTION END -->

<!-- BUGBOT_BUG_ID: 5beaff89-fa32-401a-854b-d6bae7f87930 -->

PR161 @cursor[bot] apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/components/EmbeddedTerminal.tsx:201
### Replay drops output after async write

**Medium Severity**

<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
Chunked `writeXtermScrollback` stretches the window where `attached` is false, but catch-up is still a single follow-up `snapshot` that only applies when `second.startsWith(first)`. Live `onData` is dropped during those rAF yields. Once the 256 KB cap slides, the prefix check fails and the delta is skipped, so remount can show a gap until the next replay.
<!-- DESCRIPTION END -->

<!-- BUGBOT_BUG_ID: 15c400f9-4e31-40d5-a413-df97c5952ceb -->
